title: Spaces & Phases
desc: Divide a project into spaces, run each through its phases, assign the person responsible.
note: MODULE MANIFEST — the presence of THIS file is what auto-discovery HEAD-probes (platform/discovery/discovery.js). A module registered built:true in the company manifest but missing this file is treated as deleted, and every route renders empty with zero console errors.
ownership: wa_phases was SEEDED for the cost-control plan on 2026-07-28 as project-level rows and read by no screen. This module owns it now and re-seeded it with a `space` foreign key, so there is one phase table rather than two competing ones; the project-level view is derived. wa_projects stays owned by `projects` — registering a project is still done there, so there is only ever one creation path.
plan: companies/woodart/PROJECT-BREAKDOWN-PLAN.md — slice 1 of 6. Slice 2 adds wa_requirements (materials · labour · contracted work per phase) and the Material Demand screen.
